title: Restart Down Payment on Deficiency Balance Accounts: Collection Reference Card
content:
**Policy.** This policy figures the restart down payment that a new payment plan requires on an open account held under Deficiency Balance Accounts that had a broken arrangement in the rolling 12 months while its broken arrangements remain below the band's limit on broken arrangements. Where the account had a broken arrangement in the rolling 12 months (at least one), a new plan also requires a restart down payment, figured on the balance on the day it is figured and collected as a payment on the account that carries no arrangement; an account without a broken arrangement in the rolling 12 months needs no restart down payment.

## Where the policy applies

| Account fact | Restart down payment |
|---|---|
| Open, at least one broken arrangement in the rolling 12 months, broken arrangements below the band's limit | Required for a new plan; figured on the balance on the day it is figured |
| No broken arrangement in the rolling 12 months | Not required |

The restart down payment is a payment on the account's ledger that carries no arrangement; it is not a term of any plan offer.

## How the payment is taken

`pay_restart_down_payment_04892a83` is the borrower's own payment tool. The representative unlocks it and hands it over; the customer themselves (the borrower) runs it, authorising a one-time payment from their own checking account through the self-service bank payment channel. The payment is not tied to any payment plan or settlement.

### Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `deficiency_account_id` | The reference number of the borrower's Deficiency Balance Account the payment is posted to, as returned by the deficiency account lookup for this borrower | Account reference number |
| `amount_usd` | The down payment amount the borrower authorises | USD, 2 decimal places, 0.00 or more; rounded half up to 2 decimal places when posted |

### Effect and receipt

The payment is posted on the account's ledger on today's date as a self-service bank payment carrying no arrangement, the balance is reduced by the amount paid, and the account's latest payment date becomes today. The receipt shows:

- `status`: "posted" when the payment is on the ledger
- `deficiency_txn_id`: reference number of the posted payment
- `deficiency_account_id`: the account paid
- `amount_usd`: amount posted, USD, 2 decimal places
- `payment_channel`: always `ach_self_service`
- `txn_date`: posting date, YYYY-MM-DD
- `deficiency_balance_usd`: the balance after the payment, USD, 2 decimal places

## Basis Q&A

**Does every new plan need a restart down payment?** No. Only an account with at least one broken arrangement in the rolling 12 months needs one; an account without one needs none.

**Is the down payment written into the plan offer?** No. It is collected as a payment on the account carrying no arrangement.

**On which balance is it figured?** On the balance on the day it is figured.
